text_block_list.text:
The race is over... Мэдзиро Райан's
impassioned
shouts of victory echo
throughout the course.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite having lost, Мэдзиро МакКуин

compliments Ryan on her win, declaring
this the
beginning of a golden age for
the Mejiro family.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With this great achievement, the Kikuka
Sho
draws to a close.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our next race is the Arima Kinen. Mejiro
Ryan
must now prepare for a race where
many new,
strong opponents await.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
